# Scenario: nginx routing rollback after failed ACME (same domain identity).
# 1) Deploy domain + cert none → plain HTTP answers.
# 2) Switch same domain to prod ACME against 429 stub → conf rewritten then
#    restored; live :80 still serves HTTP (no broken TLS vhost left up).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: domain http-none baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# Cycle 1: domain HTTP, no ACME.
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf --resolve e2e-rollback.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-rollback.apinfra.test/
stdout 'OK'
! exec curl -skf --max-time 3 --resolve e2e-rollback.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-rollback.apinfra.test/

# Cycle 2: same domain + prod; ACME rate-limits; routing rolled back to HTTP-none.
acme-ratelimit-start
chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.domain-prod.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: switch to domain ACME prod'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'rate limited domain=e2e-rollback.apinfra.test'
stderr 'rolled back those service confs'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf --resolve e2e-rollback.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-rollback.apinfra.test/
stdout 'OK'
! exec curl -skf --max-time 3 --resolve e2e-rollback.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-rollback.apinfra.test/

acme-ratelimit-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
# Cycle 2 keeps proxy compose unchanged; ACME needs proxyReadyAfter elapsed.
proxyReadyAfter=1s
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://localhost:18080/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://localhost:18080/directory

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-rollback.apinfra.test
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.domain-prod.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-rollback.apinfra.test
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
